sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/syracuse.json: worked. Most entries are residential remodelers or stores. JP Construction Specialties was the only Division 10 hit. Resolving the Google redirect links led to the Syracuse Builders Exchange directory.

Syracuse Builders Exchange public directory (web.syrabex.com, CSI categories 10160/10161/10162 toilet partitions, 10800 bathroom accessories, 10500 lockers, 10600 partitions): worked, the best source for this area.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): page loads but rep results are built by JavaScript, so none could be read.
ASI find-a-rep (americanspecialties.com): redirected; not followed further. Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions and Ampco locators: not tried because of time and search limits.

The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): blocked (403) on the Buffalo-Syracuse toilet partitions region page (region=40, class=3070) and on iProView profiles. A search snippet says the region page lists 17 companies but doesn't name them. Worth a manual browser visit.
BuildingConnected / Procore public profiles: not tried (search cap).

BBB category pages: Syracuse and Rochester 'partition' and Syracuse 'bathroom-accessories' pages loaded. They yielded Susquehanna Sheet Metal Erection Service (Eden NY, lockers and partitions, Western NY, about 150 miles away, outside the radius) and 10100 Inc. (Grand Island NY, gym dividers, not relevant). The Utica 'partition' page listed only firms in CT, NJ and Dover Plains NY.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 used. Results were mostly downstate or national firms: Mavi New York, CME, Division10 Inc NJ, 10-SPEC (Marlboro NJ, claims statewide NY service including Syracuse), CS Installers (Ronkonkoma NY, Northeast), One Point Partitions (delivery only; site 403), The Partition Pros (national, DFW crew, installer network elsewhere). All are excluded as beyond 120 miles or without a local base.

Excluded after checking: DS Specialties (Mooers NY, about 170 miles; carries Bobrick, Bradley, ASI, Scranton, General and Global Partitions, install not stated), Henderson-Johnson Co (Syracuse; operable partitions and storage, no toilet partitions shown), Division 10 Specialties Inc (Pembroke MA), Universal Bathrooms (Liverpool; residential bathroom remodeler per Thumbtack and Yocale), F.W. Webb (supply chain), Aventus NV (national general contractor), S & L Specialty Contracting (MapQuest page wouldn't load; unverified).

candidates.name: Weswood Specialties (AAC Contracting dba Weswood Specialties)
candidates.partition_evidence: Products page is headed 'Products We Install' and lists 'Toilet Partitions & Accessories' under Division 10; says it 'supplies and installs' products from leading manufacturers. About page: installation company for Div 10/12/14, founded 2005.
red_flags: Furnishes and installs (supplies product itself): buy-around risk
Listed projects look Rochester-area (RIT, Nazareth, The Marshall Rochester); no Syracuse/central NY project shown
Service area stated only as 'Atlantic Northeast', about 75 miles from Syracuse
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 installer whose install list includes toilet partitions; based near Rochester and says it serves the Atlantic Northeast, so plausibly covers Syracuse but it also supplies partitions itself.
